title: Ends tonight
sub: Four sales close at midnight: denim, tailoring, pajamas and basics.

brands.say: Karlee denim chore jacket was $258, now $90, all sizes. Cassie high rise straight jean $188 to $94 in all 11 sizes. Ilona bubble hem dress $178 to $62.
brands.why_not: All three are final sale. Homepage headline is 30% off; these are the deeper sale-section prices.

items.name: Ilona Bubble Hem Dress
items.note: Navy bubble-hem mini, 65% off, all sizes

brands.say: UK store, prices in pounds. Hero: Wool Mix Tweed Blazer in brown, was 255 pounds, now 127.50, half off, all 8 sizes in stock. Oversized grey coat was 255, now 178.50. Framed neckline maxi dress was 175, now 70.
brands.why_not: UK store: was/now are GBP, not USD; US buyers should check shipping and duties. Return terms not shown in the catalog.

items.name: Wool-mix tweed blazer
items.note: Sculpted hourglass tweed blazer, 8/8 sizes, strongest photo of the brand

items.name: Oversized Grey Coat
items.note: Long double-breasted grey wool-look coat, 5/5 sizes, only 30% off but a real staple

items.name: Framed Neck Maxi Dress
items.note: Black long-sleeve square-neck column dress for dinner, 60% off, 5/8 sizes

brands.say: Hero is the Pima fair isle pajama set in navy, was $124, now $62, every size in stock. Relax jogger set in French blue is $72 from $144. Wander ribbed knit jogger set is $172 from $288. Final sale, no returns.
brands.why_not: Homepage advertises 25% off sitewide; these are deeper sale-section markdowns.

items.name: Fair Isle Pima PJ Set
items.note: Holiday fair isle print, half off, all 7 sizes, strong on-model photo

items.name: Relax Jogger Set
items.note: Soft blue lounge set, half off, 5 of 7 sizes

items.name: Wander Ribbed Knit Set
items.note: Sweater-knit lounge set, biggest saving at $116, all sizes

brands.say: Perfect Pima pajama shirt was $58, now $29, all seven sizes. Matching pajama pants $68 to $34. Cloud Cotton long sleeve tee and pant set $106 to $66.
brands.why_not: Low price points, so dollar savings are small. The pima pajama pieces are final sale and sold separately.
